title: Chapter 101 Tiger Cade
content:
Chapter 101 Tiger Cade

"You have to ask Xu Qing about this. She asked me to inform you two." Fang Kai said coldly.

Xie Fan, who was standing at the edge in white clothes, glanced at the round-headed Zhang Jinsheng, with a hint of smile in his eyes, and said first: "Jin Sheng, don't be anxious, watch this big show, isn't it good-looking?"

His voice is as gentle as jade and very magnetic.

"I met this lord once. He was only level 12 at the time. Look at the strength of his territory. Isn't it surprising?"

"If you say such boring words again, I'm leaving. I don't have time to play around with you here." Zhang Jinsheng rolled his eyes at him and prepared to leave.

At this time, the girl in green clothes among the four took a step and shouted quickly: "Zhang Jinsheng, Dongfang Ling is inside."

"Why tell him so early!" Xie Fan curled his lips and complained somewhat boringly.

"What? Dongfang Ling is inside?" Zhang Jinsheng's eyes widened with a surprised expression.

His eyes swept over Fang Kai and Xie Fan one by one, his eyebrows twisted, and he said angrily: "Humph, you two have known this for a long time, right?"

His tone was obviously unkind and slightly angry.

"Then why don't you hurry in and save people? All of you, especially Fang Kai. If something happens to Dongfang Ling, Lord Qingyang will never spare you."

Among these four people, one is Dongfang Ling's best friend, two are her suitors, and the other is Dongfang Ke, who is specially arranged to protect Dongfang Ling as a bodyguard, and also likes Dongfang Ling.

"Why are you panicking? It's not confirmed yet. The eldest lady must be inside!"

"Even if the city wall is broken, I am confident that I can rescue her!" Fang Kai looked calm and composed.

"Okay, okay, you are amazing! You are noble!"

Zhang Jinsheng turned his head and sulked.

The bulging cheeks made his head even more round.

Although he was anxious, he did not dare to rush into the herd alone.

The fighting continues in the distance.

Hear Wang Shuo's order.

Suo Yong immediately arranged manpower to reinforce the inner wall with city wall defense talismans.

When the inner wall was reached, the light wall also lit up.

Wang Shuo said to all the subjects: "Big fellow, if you grit your teeth and persevere, victory is right in front of you."

The number of wild beasts outside is at most tens of thousands.

Most of the people in the territory cheered immediately.

But Wang Shuo knew that the most dangerous battle had not yet begun.

Sure enough, the bosses in the distance started to move.

"Everyone, it's your turn!"

There was a gap in Toad Brunei's huge mouth, and a deep voice squeezed out from it.

At this time, he couldn't help but feel a bit of surprise in his heart: "A small lord can actually resist half of the beasts in the entire Changping County. He is worthy of being an iron-blooded lord and a key person to 'take care of'."

He snorted coldly, and a huge stream of air blew out from his two nostrils the size of millstones.

"I don't know if he can block my blow!"

As he spoke, he stood up slowly, and suddenly, there was a shaking around him.

He just moved his legs a little. Maybe he had been squatting for too long and was a little numb!

The remaining nine bosses immediately fled from the vicinity of the toad and rushed towards it, as if they were given an amnesty.

Wang Shuo saw from a distance that the seriously injured wild antelope boss Kress was following the two silver bosses.

"The situation is not good!" he muttered.

He turned to the logistics team and said, "Logistics staff, retreat to the inner wall first."

"Other personnel, move closer to me."

Wang Shuohun felt a little tight in his chest, as if a big stone was pressing on it, and an inexplicable uneasy feeling filled his mind.

This is an unprecedentedly powerful force, facing 9 bosses at the same time, and there is also a golden boss that dominates the battle.

To be honest, it is definitely a lie.

The members of the militia squad and the cavalry squad quickly approached him.

After this battle of blood and fire, Wang Shuo's prestige in the territory reached its peak.

People with a loyalty level of 90 or above already account for half.

"Lord, Lord, what should we do now?"

Someone from the militia team swallowed his saliva and asked stutteringly.

The members of the cavalry team are much calmer, and the combat qualities of each of them are no longer what they used to be.

Before Wang Shuo could answer, a voice sounded in the distance.

"attack."

The person who issued the order to attack was a tiger with a body length of more than 5 meters.

Wang Shuo checked his information.

[Tiger (ID: Tiger 10031 Cade, Silver Boss)]

[Level: Level 24]

[Attack power: 520]

[Defense: 160]

[Health value: 12000]

[Skills: Tiger Roar, Claw Strike, Pounce. 】

Compared with the bronze boss, its attributes are much higher.
